review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company BNY is a premier global financial services organization renowned for its innovative approach and commitment to excellence. As a key player in the financial industry, BNY influences nearly 20% of the world's investible assets, shaping the future of finance through advanced technology and strategic insights. The company fosters a culture of continuous growth, collaboration, and innovation, empowering employees to excel and make a meaningful impact worldwide. With a dedication to leveraging cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies, BNY consistently drives transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities globally. About The Role We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Vice President, Principal Full Stack Engineer to join our Performance Product Engineering team in Boston, MA. This pivotal role is designed for a technical leader who excels in architecture, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration. As a senior technical authority, you will be responsible for defining and guiding the technical direction of our performance measurement and attribution calculation platform, which underpins our wealth management and asset servicing products. Your influence will extend across multiple teams, shaping system architecture, establishing standards, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions. Qualifications Over 10 years of experience in building and operating complex production software systems, with demonstrated expertise in at least one side of the technology stack. Proven track record of owning and architecting systems used by multiple teams, with the ability to define and implement comprehensive design strategies. Extensive background in data-intensive, distributed, or high-throughput systems, with a focus on correctness, performance, and scalability. Strong influence on technical direction through well-argued design documents, prototypes, and peer reviews, without formal authority. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving legacy systems, ensuring stability and continuous improvement. Experience in the financial services, capital markets, or investment performance/attribution domain is advantageous but not mandatory; relevant domain expertise can be developed. Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, JVM languages, and familiarity with cloud platforms like Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes, and related technologies. Responsibilities Own and evolve the architecture of the calculation platform, including data models, computation engines, orchestration, APIs, and client interfaces. Make strategic build/buy/refactor decisions and articulate the rationale behind them. Lead cross-team design reviews, establish architectural patterns, and address integration challenges that span multiple teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and system cohesion. Partner closely with leadership, including the Director of Engineering and product teams, to translate business goals into technical strategies and vice versa, ensuring alignment and clarity. Prototype, evaluate, and lead the adoption of emerging technologies such as AI and ML, balancing innovation with practical implementation to enhance product capabilities. Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, elevating engineering standards and best practices in design, testing, performance, and correctness, especially in high-stakes financial systems. Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, infrastructure, and documentation, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability. Benefits BNY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive compensation, health insurance plans, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities, including training programs, certifications, and conferences. The company promotes a flexible work environment that encourages work-life balance and supports remote work arrangements. Additionally, BNY provides wellness programs, employee assistance services, and a vibrant corporate culture that values diversity, inclusion, and community engagement. Equal Opportunity BNY is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and succeed, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who share our values and commitment to excellence.

review_candidates.title: Backend engineer senior (freelance)
review_candidates.description: Home Jobs Terug naar overzicht Backend engineer senior (freelance) VRT is op zoek naar een Senior Backend Engineer. De afdeling Digitale Producten van VRT is op zoek naar een Senior Backend Engineer om de teams van Digitale Producten te versterken. De afdeling Digitale Producten is de plaats waar digitale producten vorm krijgen. In nauwe samenwerking met de verschillende merken (VRT Eén, Canvas, Ketnet, Sporza, VRT NWS, VRT MAX en onze vijf radiomerken) ontwikkelen wij nieuwe producten; van websites tot social media campagnes en mobiele apps. Je komt in een uiterst dynamische omgeving terecht waar je mee verantwoordelijk bent voor de realisatie van een sterk uitgebouwd digitaal aanbod, dat dagelijks een groot en breed publiek aanspreekt. Vanuit jouw expertise zet je mee je schouders onder een kwalitatieve digitale portfolio voor VRT, in een context die sterk in evolutie is. Je beschikt over aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare backenddiensten. Je hebt een sterke Java-achtergrond, werkt vlot in moderne cloud- en CI/CD-omgevingen en denkt actief mee over robuuste API’s, performante datastromen en betrouwbare integraties. Je hebt ervaring met event-based architecturen en kan technische keuzes onderbouwen binnen een complexe digitale productomgeving. Ervaring met CQRS is een duidelijke meerwaarde. Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst en heb jij het lef en de skills om onze digitale producten naar een nog hoger niveau te brengen? Dan maken we graag kennis! Wat kom je bij ons doen? Je bent lid van een cross-functioneel agile team dat een vlekkeloze media-ervaring wil uitbouwen en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van betrouwbare, schaalbare en onderhoudbare backendoplossingen. Samen met je collega’s bouw je end-to-end aan digitale producten, van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie, monitoring en ondersteuning in productie. Je helpt actief bij het verbeteren van bestaande backendservices, met aandacht voor performantie, stabiliteit, security en schaalbaarheid. Ontwerpen en implementeren van backendcomponenten, API’s en integraties binnen een event-based architectuur. Samenwerken met ontwikkelaars, architecten, product owners en business stakeholders om technische oplossingen af te stemmen op productdoelstellingen. Technische risico’s detecteren, verbeteringen voorstellen en actief bijdragen aan codekwaliteit, observability en operational excellence. Opzetten en onderhouden van CI/CD-pijplijnen, automatische checks en technische kwaliteitsstandaarden. Coachen van collega’s en delen van backendexpertise binnen en buiten het team. Wie ben jij? Je kan technische keuzes vertalen naar robuuste backendarchitectuur en houdt daarbij rekening met schaalbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid, security en operationele betrouwbaarheid. Je vertaalt productnoden en stories naar heldere technische implementaties en denkt mee over API-contracten, datamodellen en integratiepatronen. Je identificeert technische trends, risico’s en verbeterkansen op het vlak van backendontwikkeling, event-based architecturen en cloud-native engineering. Je schrijft kwalitatieve, goed geteste code en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor oplossingen van ontwerp tot productie. Je neemt het voortouw in technische verbeteringen en trekt het team mee in engineering best practices, pragmatische documentatie en kennisdeling. Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring in een digitale productomgeving of mediasector. Je communiceert vlot met technische en niet-technische stakeholders en kan complexe technische onderwerpen helder toelichten. Verder heb je aantoonbare ervaring in: Backend engineering in een agile omgeving (8 jaar) Java ontwikkeling (8 jaar) NodeJS / Typescript ontwikkeling (5 jaar) Event-based architecturen (5 jaar) API design en integratiepatronen (5 jaar) CI/CD, monitoring en operationele ondersteuning van backenddiensten (3 jaar) Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, ...) (3 jaar) CQRS ervaring bij voorkeur Go ervaring of interesse is een pluspunt Wat bieden wij jou? Je krijgt niet alleen de kans om mee te bouwen aan het digitale verhaal van de VRT, maar ook om de koers mee te bepalen. Je komt terecht in een zeer flexibele en inspirerende omgeving waarin innovatie, creativiteit en experimenteren deel uitmaken van het DNA. Je krijgt de ruimte voor zelfontplooiing om de beste te worden in jouw domein. De VRT is een mensgerichte organisatie, die aandacht heeft voor een goede work-life balance. Je krijgt een voltijds contract voor een freelance opdracht via tussenpersoon en dit voor 1 jaar. In onderling overleg is verlenging en tariefaanpassingen mogelijk (Max. 3 maal verlengbaar en tariefaanpassingen maximaal volgens de geldende agoria-index). De opdracht wordt gegund aan 1 of meer partijen. Interesse? Als je op ‘Solliciteren’ klikt word je doorgestuurd naar de marktplaats van ‘Connecting-Expertise’. Maak een leveranciersaccount aan of log in op de marktplaats als je al een account hebt. Klik linksboven in het menu op de tab “requests & proposals”. Klik vervolgens op de tab “received requests” waar je een overzicht van je aanvragen kan terugvinden. Zoek in het overzicht op VRT[referentienummer] (bv: VRT123456). Via de tab “create a proposal” in de aanvraag is het mogelijk om een offerte met je CV en motivatiebrief in te indienen. VRT zet zich actief in om een inclusieve omgeving te voorzien voor alle medewerkers. We zijn er als publieke omroep voor iedereen in Vlaanderen, daarom vinden we het belangrijk om in ons personeel ook de diversiteit te zien die onze samenleving rijk is. Iedereen verschillend, iedereen welkom! Solliciteren Meer info Contracttype Zelfstandige contract via tussenpersoon Referentienummer 389443 Deel Vacature Terug naar overzicht

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - C# / PLC (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary At Colibrium Additive, part of GE Aerospace, we work every day to bring the transformative power of additive manufacturing to businesses around the globe. In this role, you will design, develop, deliver, and maintain software applications and services that run our additive manufacturing machines. Your main focus will be on on-machine software development for electron beam-based additive manufacturing systems, primarily using C#/.NET and Python, as well as PLC programming to support machine functionality and future technology development. This role is ideal for a hands-on software engineer who enjoys working close to the machine, combining application software, industrial communication, and controls-related development in an advanced manufacturing environment. This role is based in Mölndal, Gothenburg, and we offer a hybrid working model with up to two home-office days per week. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities In This Role, You Will Develop and enhance our EBM (Electron Beam Melting) on-machine software products in close collaboration with Product Management, Engineering leadership, and other software teams. Design, build, test, and maintain Windows-based machine software primarily in C#/.NET. Develop and maintain Siemens PLC code in TIA Portal to support machine control and future machine technology developments. Contribute to software solutions used for process control, as well as pre-processing and post-processing of data relevant to the additive manufacturing process. Define and implement robust and scalable client-server interfaces and asynchronous communication mechanisms. Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum team to refine requirements, develop technical solutions, and deliver high-quality software increments. Create and maintain technical documentation, including specifications, interface descriptions, and design documentation. Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, improve machine functionality, and support software deployment in a production environment. Support and coach team members by sharing technical knowledge and software development best practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another STEM-related field. Several years of professional experience in software development for industrial systems, machine software, automation software, or similar technical environments. Strong hands-on experience in C#/.NET and object-oriented software development; Python experience is a plus. Experience with or strong interest in PLC programming and working closely with machine hardware and industrial systems. Interest in working close to machine hardware and industrial processes. Good understanding of the software development lifecycle, including Agile methods, testing, maintainability, and software quality practices. Fluent in English. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and teams. Desired Characteristics Experience with Siemens PLCs and TIA Portal. Experience with Python. Experience in additive manufacturing or other industrial machinery / automation environments. Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, WebSocket, or similar. Comfortable working in a multidisciplinary environment combining software, hardware, and process engineering. Curious, hands-on mindset with a strong willingness to learn and solve technical problems. Ability to balance technical depth with pragmatic execution in a fast-evolving engineering environment. Colibrium Additive, part of GE Aerospace, is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Why join us At Colibrium Additive, part of GE Aerospace, you will work in a flexible, innovative, and technically advanced environment at the forefront of additive manufacturing. We believe great work happens when people are supported both professionally and personally. That is why we encourage flexible working arrangements where possible and value a healthy work-life balance. This role is based in Mölndal, Gothenburg, and we offer a hybrid working model with up to two home-office days per week. Joining our team means becoming part of a global and collaborative organization where you can: Work on exciting and meaningful technology Grow your skills in an advanced engineering environment Collaborate with experienced and committed colleagues from different cultures Benefit from flexible working hours as well as health and pension insurance benefits Build valuable experience that contributes to your long-term development It is our people that make the difference. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Developer
review_candidates.description: About The Role Senior Software Developer 📍Location: Gorinchem, Netherlands (Hybrid) Industry: Software Development / Industrial Technology / Technology Solutions Job Function: Software Engineering / Software Development Employment Type: Full-Time We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer to join a highly technical and collaborative engineering team based in Gorinchem on a Hybrid basis. This is an opportunity to work on complex software systems where modern cloud-native technologies intersect with existing enterprise, embedded, and industrial software environments. The successful candidate will play a key role in designing scalable architectures, modernising existing systems, and delivering robust software solutions that support long-term business objectives. You will work in an Agile Scrum environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams while contributing to architectural decisions, technical strategy, and continuous improvement initiatives. This position is ideal for a software engineer who thrives in complexity, enjoys solving challenging technical problems, and can balance innovation with the realities of existing software landscapes. You will have the opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor others through best practices, and help shape future-proof solutions within a highly structured engineering environment. Key Responsibilities Design and evolve scalable software architectures that support long-term maintainability and technical sustainability. Develop and maintain backend and full-stack software solutions using Microsoft technologies and modern development frameworks. Work within complex software environments, including legacy systems, enterprise applications, and embedded software components. Build, maintain, and optimise APIs and system integrations across distributed environments. Contribute to software modernisation initiatives, including migration projects involving .NET Core and modern .NET architectures. Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to define technical solutions and implementation strategies. Participate actively in Agile Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure software quality, performance, scalability, and security through best engineering practices. Support architectural decision-making and provide technical guidance on complex development projects. Identify opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and maintainability. Your Profile Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Proven experience as a Senior Software Developer or Senior Software Engineer working on complex software systems. Strong expertise in C#, .NET Framework, and modern .NET technologies. Experience designing and delivering scalable, maintainable backend solutions. Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices. Experience working within Agile Scrum development environments. Ability to work effectively within both modern and legacy software landscapes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for software delivery. Fluent in both English and Dutch. Preferred Experience .NET Core, .NET 6, .NET 8, or later versions. Cloud-native application development. API development and systems integration. Enterprise software development. Embedded or industrial software environments. Distributed systems and microservices architectures. Software modernisation and migration projects. Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices. What We Offer Competitive salary and benefits package. Long-term career development and progression opportunities. Supportive team culture with opportunities to contribute to technical strategy and decision-making. Apply today or contact Arthur Mahoney for more information about this opportunity.
